ActorTalk: That's not right! You have all those... weird tricks! It's just not fair!
If it weren't for that... technology, you never would have caught me!
That's not fair. I didn't even cause any problems. All I did was send some code to Kuroro.
You're not in anyone's way. Why are you running?
Then why did you send the code to Kuroro? What was your real goal?
My goal, huh... I just wanted to study how Kuroros works.
You're lying. The chaos I ran into, and what you just tried to do—it was all to make Kuroro arrange certain characters "autonomously".
Which you can then extract information from.
What are you planning to do?
When I was going through the archives earlier, I found something called "Kuroro encoding". It was a niche back in the Golden Age, and allowed Kuroros to translate certain information.
Lute, you had a piece of code like that in your possession. I'm guessing this whole commotion started because you wanted to decode it?
Enough talk. I'll just create a virtual environment and simulate the information you want so desperately.
